propositions: Repository-wide audit of documentation, comments, and embedded prose against operator standards requires systematic inventory and evidence-based remediation proposals before any file changes.

Audit standards establish requirements for punctuation, diction, formal voice, paragraph structure, audience targeting, filler removal, and authenticity claims across authored prose in all maintained documentation surfaces.

Three exploration shards own distinct surface families: durable records and internal documentation, external documentation and shipped help, and developer comments with embedded prose; cross-shard filtering validates evidence, factual accuracy, placement, completeness, and conformance.

Foundation work F01-F07 establishes documentation ownership policy, maintained prose review, validation mechanisms, comment policy, generated source ownership, documentation navigation, and index coverage.

External documentation and shipped help defects F08-F29 address client README, certificates, imports, CLI options, command discovery, MCP summaries, adoption templates, demonstration assets, example workflows, user guides, configuration, identity setup, Jira synchronization, and contributor workflow.

Internal documentation, durable records, and operator prose defects F30-F49 address architecture, event contracts, concurrency, migrations, ADR lifecycle, archives, runbooks, Jira backend, comments, prompts, diagnostics, research records, and provenance metadata.
